enumeration.arithmetic: exact Cubic7 arithmetic and certified real-embedding signs
enumeration.cone_rays: all codimension-d supports, reduced through the B_(d-1)xA1 cone kernel
enumeration.ordinary_coordinates: dominant ordered square partitions; zero padding records stabilization

records.local_norm_class_proof: For primitive r, q(r) divides 2I(r). Away from (2), I(r) is locally O. At (2), either I(r)=O or every non-final coordinate is in (2) and r_final is a unit; then q(r)=2*r_final^2 mod (4), so v_2(q)=1. Thus the norm ideals are exactly among (1),(2).

scope.warning: A hyperideal ray in a bounded Vinberg prefix proves only that this prefix has not closed; later exact roots can cut it off.

records.local_norm_class_proof: For primitive r, q(r) divides 2I(r). Away from (2) and p=(2-theta), I(r) is locally O. If I(r) is nontrivial at p, the non-final coordinates lie in p and r_final is a unit, so q(r)=(2-theta)*r_final^2 mod p^2 and v_p(q)=1. The inert prime (2) occurs to exponent at most one. Hence (1),(2),p,(2)p.

scope.warning: A hyperideal ray in a bounded Vinberg prefix proves only that this prefix has not closed; later exact roots can cut it off.
